title: Neural Classifiers as Error-Correcting Codes
abstract: arXiv:2611.18239v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A unified framework is proposed that characterizes supervised deep classification as the decoding of error-correcting codes in the Shannon sense. Cross-entropy optimization is shown to align softmax classifiers with maximum-likelihood decoding, where logits map to Hamming distances to class-specific codewords. This correspondence explains the emergence of standard divergence objectives (e.g., Kullback-Leibler, Jeffreys) and provides a geometric basis for the stability of decision boundaries. Furthermore, the geometries of Neural Collapse and LeJEPA are identified as optimal constellations for decoding under isotropic noise. Unlike classical Error-Correcting Output Codes, deep networks are shown to learn effective codebooks in the feature space implicitly. translated_abstract: 本文提出了一个统一框架，将监督深度分类刻画为香农意义下的纠错码译码过程。研究表明，交叉熵优化使softmax分类器与最大似然译码相一致，其中logits映射为到各类别特定码字的汉明距离。这种对应关系解释了标准散度目标（如Kullback-Leibler散度、Jeffreys散度）的出现，并为决策边界的稳定性提供了几何基础。此外，Neural Collapse与LeJEPA的几何结构被识别为各向同性噪声下译码的最优星座图。与经典的纠错输出码不同，研究表明深度网络能够在特征空间中隐式地学习有效的码本。基于这一见解，本文推导出用于无损量化、改进知识蒸馏以及基于码冗余的结构正则化的新准则。最后，这一……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出统一框架，将监督深度分类刻画为香农意义下的纠错码译码，证明交叉熵优化等价于最大似然译码，深度网络在特征空间中隐式学习码本，并据此推导出无损量化、知识蒸馏和结构正则化的新准则。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework characterizing supervised deep classification as Shannon-style error-correcting code decoding, shows cross-entropy optimization aligns with maximum-likelihood decoding and that deep networks implicitly learn codebooks in feature space, deriving novel criteria for lossless quantization, knowledge distillation, and architectural regularization.
